title: The Whirling Throw: Advanced Javelin Forms
summary: Advanced forms that spin the whole body into the throw to give the shaft a heavy and curving flight.

title: Breaking the Shield Line: An Advanced Treatise
summary: A treatise on finding the weak overlap in a line of shields and throwing javelins to split it open.

title: The Long-Flight Canon of Distant Casting
summary: A canon on sending the javelin to extreme distance with a thread of qi that holds its line.

title: Javelin Against Armour and Beast: Advanced Hunt Forms
summary: Advanced forms for piercing plate and thick hide and for stopping a charging beast with a single cast.

title: Twin-Shaft Forms of the River Hand
summary: Teaches a dual-track method of holding two javelins and flowing from throw to thrust like a river.

title: The Azure Hawk Stoop
summary: Teaches throwing from a height in a hawk's stoop so the shaft falls steeply and fast.

title: Basin and River: The Dual-Track Javelin Canon
summary: A canon that joins the thrown track and the held track so one thrower covers far and near.

title: Wind-Sworn Javelin Bearings
summary: Teaches the wind-sworn thrower to take a bearing on the mark and hold it through draw and release.

title: The Plateau Skirmisher's Oath-Book
summary: An oath-book for plateau skirmishers on holding the open line and falling back without breaking the oath.

title: Open-Sky Casting: The Gale Javelin Forms
summary: Forms for the thrower who fights in the open with no cover behind and trusts only wind and bearing.
